parker-cs: Heads-up: Aurora Analytics renewal. Customer wants invoice to Aurora APAC Pty Ltd (AU entity) but payment will be drawn from Aurora US (corporate card). They flagged GST handling and said APAC bookkeeping needs invoice today to attach to PO. Can legal/finance advise?
yuki-am: Any change to term/pricing? They previously asked about a 6mo trial then convert to 12mo.
parker-cs: They confirmed 12mo. Customer asked for a 7% one-time "onboarding" concession if we accept mixed-entity billing and net60. PO: AU-PO-6610. Signer: "Samir R., Head of Finance".
aman-legal: Mixed-entity payor is OK if we get VAT/GST registration or a signed remit authorization plus indemnity. For AU we can accept electronic signature; include clause: "Billing Entity Confirmation: Customer confirms Aurora APAC Pty Ltd is the billed entity; Aurora US Corp authorizes payment on its behalf and will indemnify Redwood Inference for any GST/VAT mismatches."
tess-fin: Finance: we prefer wire to AU account (BIC/IBAN not used in AU). If they insist on US card, we need vendor code + completed tax form W-8/W-9 equivalent and remit authorization. Also need to know if invoice should show GST.
parker-cs: Customer provided vendor code: AUR-VC-55. They say they will try AU electronic funds transfer (EFT) via PayID first, fallback to US card if payment not cleared by 2024-05-10. Requested invoice in AUD to avoid FX.
yuki-am: I'll note the 7% concession request but hold until legal signs off. If indemnity required we likely can't approve credit.
aman-legal: I'll prepare a short addendum and push for e-sign via AdobeSign/DocuSign link. Sample indemnity language ready. If they provide GST reg number and vendor code we can skip indemnity.
esign-bot: eSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/AU-ENV-9922 status: sent (1 pending signer).
tess-fin: I'll draft two invoice variants: (1) AUD invoice to Aurora APAC Pty Ltd with PayID details and GST line, (2) AUD invoice with payor field = Aurora US Corp and CC fallback instructions. ETA 40m.
parker-cs: Sent addendum to customer and asked them to confirm PayID details + GST reg. They replied they'll get GST reg # to us within the day and sign the addendum.
yuki-am: Great. Keep me posted on signature and payment method. If they insist on the 7% credit I'll escalate to pricing for a one-time allowance.
parker-cs: Will do. I'll post when envelope signed or if finance needs anything else. :thumbsup:
